description: Pre-built Node.js native distributions from the official nodejs.org releases (node, npm, npx and corepack). Supports Windows (x64, arm64), macOS (x64, arm64), and Linux (x64, arm64). The node distribution is automatically copied to the runtimes/{rid}/node-native directory during build, and the bundled NodeCli helpers locate it, fix its execute permission and run scripts or eval snippets with redirected stdin/stdout/stderr.
title: Node.js Native Binary
